a luminous porcelain-fair complexion with a cool-pink undertone, early 20s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, shaggy layered chocolate brown hair — wearing a skin-tight ultra-high-cut micro swimsuit of glossy white patent vinyl, made of two small triangle cups held by thin halter strings behind her neck and back, joined to the bottom by two thin vertical straps of the same vinyl about two fingers apart that run down on either side of her navel from the lower corners of the cups to the top corners of the bottom, linked by three small horizontal straps with polished silver buckles stacked down the center of her stomach, her waist sides, her flanks and the skin between and around the straps bare, the bottom is only a small triangle at the front cut extremely high up to the very top of her hip bones, her hips, thighs and legs completely bare, the vinyl shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her arms bare, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small mole near her collarbone and slightly darker skin over her elbows. The materials show real behaviour: the polished silver buckles catching small bright highlights, the glossy vinyl molded so closely that it shows the dip of her navel, her ribs and her hip bones, a wet-looking sheen sliding over each contour. Jewelry: a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts, sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, and thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Japanese woman (East Asian Japanese features: a soft rounded short face with full cheeks and a small delicate chin, small narrow monolid eyes set slightly wide apart with no crease, a low soft nose bridge with a rounded tip, small modest lips, soft low flat eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: large round eyes with bright real catchlights, thick curled lashes with drawn-on lower lashes, soft pink and lilac eyeshadow, round pink blush, glossy cherry-pink lips.

Background: a grand concert hall stage with a polished wooden floor, steps down to the stalls, rows of red seats and a standard-height stage door, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
